svg.title: Mosca's inequality applied to Hyperledger Fabric deployment scenarios
svg.desc: Top panel: conceptual timeline showing X (time to CRQC), Y (migration lead time), and Z (data sensitivity lifetime). Bottom panel: five Fabric deployment scenarios plotted against the optimistic and pessimistic CRQC estimates, showing which scenarios require immediate migration.
svg.text: The inequality: if Y + Z > X then migration must begin immediately
Z = 30 years (healthcare records) — Y + Z = 33 yrs ≫ X
When the Y + Z bar extends past the CRQC marker, migration is urgent

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Why does the healthcare records Fabric deployment scenario require immediate post-quantum migration under both CRQC timeline estimates?')
g.text: Y+Z = 33 yr ≫ X in both cases

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Why does the financial settlement Fabric deployment require immediate migration?')
sendPrompt('Why does government procurement require immediate migration?')
sendPrompt('Why is the supply chain Fabric deployment borderline for post-quantum migration urgency?')
sendPrompt('Why can a two-year contract Fabric deployment defer post-quantum migration?')

svg.text: X = years to CRQC · Y = migration lead time (3 yr) · Z = data sensitivity lifetime · Migrate immediately if Y + Z > X
